heading: Specialist Behaviour Support
blockquote: Helping dogs feel calmer, more confident and better understood.
body:
The CALM Method

The CALM Method is an approach I’ve developed through years of working with nervous, fearful and anxious dogs.

I believe grooming should be about more than simply getting the job done. If a dog leaves feeling frightened or overwhelmed, the next appointment becomes even harder. That’s why the CALM Method focuses on building trust, protecting emotional wellbeing and creating positive experiences that build confidence over time.

The CALM Method is built around four simple principles:

  • Connect – Build trust before asking anything of the dog.
  • Assess – Understand what the dog is communicating through their body language.
  • Lead with Confidence – Provide calm, consistent leadership that helps the dog feel secure.
  • Move at the Dog’s Pace – Work with the dog, not against them, allowing confidence to grow naturally.

These principles guide every anxious dog groom, every owner consultation and every City & Guilds course I teach. Whether you’re looking for specialist support for your dog or want to learn this approach as a professional groomer, the CALM Method is at the heart of everything I do.
